mapper.select:
SELECT e.EQP_SQ, e.EQP_NO, e.TYPE_CD, e.BRAND_NM, e.MODEL_NM, e.SERIAL_NO, e.CPU_SPEC, e.MEM_SPEC, e.SSD_SPEC, e.HDD_SPEC, e.LAN_YN, e.ETC_TXT , e.STATUS_CD, e.LOCATION_NM, e.AUDIT_EXCL_YN, DATE_FORMAT(e.DISPOSE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DISPOSE_DT, e.DISPOSE_REASON , DATE_FORMAT(e.LAST_CHECK_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_CHECK_DT, e.LAST_CHECK_NM
, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mm.CONTENT ORDER BY mm.MEMO_SQ DESC SEPARATOR '\n') FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R mm WHERE mm.TARGET_CD = 'EQP' AND mm.TARGET_SQ = e.EQP_SQ) AS MEMO , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R mm WHERE mm.TARGET_CD = 'EQP' AND mm.TARGET_SQ = e.EQP_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT , r.RENT_SQ, r.RENT_GROUP, r.STAFF_SQ, r.HOLDER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(r.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, r.PURPOSE_NM, r.PROJECT_NM , s.STATUS_CD AS STAFF_STATUS, s.EMPLY_ID , CASE WHEN r.RENT_GROUP IS NOT NULL AND sg.SIGN_SQ IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SIGN_WAIT , d.RESULT_CD AS AUDIT_RESULT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H x WHERE x.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND x.REVIEW_DONE_YN = 'N' AND x.OPEN_YN = 'Y' AND x.START_DT IS NULL) AS REVIEW_OPEN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H x WHERE x.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND x.REVIEW_DONE_YN = 'N' AND x.OPEN_YN = 'N' AND x.START_DT IS NULL AND x.END_DT IS NULL) AS REVIEW_NODATE , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H x WHERE x.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND x.REVIEW_DONE_YN = 'N' AND x.OPEN_YN = 'N' AND x.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND x.END_DT IS NULL) AS REVIEW_NOEND FROM TB_EEP_EQP_M e LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r ON r.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND r.OPEN_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M s ON s.STAFF_SQ = r.STAFF_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_SIGN_H sg ON sg.RENT_GROUP = r.RENT_GROUP LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m ON m.STATUS_CD = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d ON d.AUDIT_SQ = m.AUDIT_SQ AND d.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ ORDER BY e.TYPE_CD, e.EQP_NO, e.EQP_SQ
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, DEPT_NM, ORG_NM, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STATUS_CD <> 'LEFT' ORDER BY STAFF_NM
SELECT EQP_NO FROM TB_EEP_EQP_M WHERE TYPE_CD = #{TYPE_CD} AND STATUS_CD IN ('RENT', 'STOCK')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_M (EQP_NO, TYPE_CD, BRAND_NM, MODEL_NM, SERIAL_NO, LOCATION_NM, STATUS_CD, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{EQP_NO}, #{TYPE_CD}, NULLIF(#{BRAND_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{MODEL_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{SERIAL_NO}, ''), NULLIF(#{LOCATION_NM}, ''), 'STOCK', #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M SET ${FIELD} = NULLIF(#{VALUE}, ''), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_EQP_M WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r WHERE r.EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M SET STATUS_CD = 'RENT', LOCATION_NM = NULL, UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = 'STOCK'

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M SET STATUS_CD = #{STATUS_CD}, DISPOSE_DT = #{DISPOSE_DT}, DISPOSE_REASON = NULLIF(#{DISPOSE_REASON}, ''), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND STATUS_CD IN #{s}
mapper.select: SELECT r.RENT_SQ, r.EQP_SQ, r.STAFF_SQ, r.HOLDER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(r.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(r.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT, r.OPEN_YN , r.PURPOSE_NM, r.PROJECT_NM, r.HANDOVER_NM, r.RENT_GROUP, r.RETURN_FORMAT_YN, r.RETURN_LABEL_YN, r.REVIEW_DONE_YN, sg.SIGN_TP, DATE_FORMAT(sg.SIGN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS SIGN_DT FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_SIGN_H sg ON sg.RENT_GROUP = r.RENT_GROUP WHERE r.EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} ORDER BY r.OPEN_YN DESC, r.START_DT DESC, r.RENT_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H (EQP_SQ, STAFF_SQ, HOLDER_NM, START_DT, OPEN_YN, PURPOSE_NM, PROJECT_NM, HANDOVER_NM, RENT_GROUP, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{EQP_SQ}, NULLIF(#{STAFF_SQ}, ''), #{HOLDER_NM}, #{START_DT}, 'Y', NULLIF(#{PURPOSE_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{PROJECT_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{HANDOVER_NM}, ''), #{RENT_GROUP}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H SET ${FIELD} = NULLIF(#{VALUE}, '') WHERE RENT_SQ = #{RENT_SQ}

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H SET OPEN_YN = 'N', END_DT = #{END_DT}, RETURN_FORMAT_YN = #{RETURN_FORMAT_YN}, RETURN_LABEL_YN = #{RETURN_LABEL_YN} WHERE RENT_SQ = #{RENT_SQ} AND OPEN_YN = 'Y' AND (START_DT IS NULL OR START_DT <= #{END_DT})

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M SET STATUS_CD = 'STOCK', LOCATION_NM = NULLIF(#{LOCATION_NM}, ''), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EQP_SQ = (SELECT EQP_SQ FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H WHERE RENT_SQ = #{RENT_SQ}) AND STATUS_CD = 'RENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R (TARGET_CD, TARGET_SQ, CONTENT, EMPLY_ID) SELECT 'EQP', EQP_SQ, CONCAT('[반납 ', #{END_DT}, '] ', #{CONTENT}), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID} FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H WHERE RENT_SQ = #{RENT_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H SET OPEN_YN = 'N', END_DT = #{DISPOSE_DT} WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND OPEN_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R (TARGET_CD, TARGET_SQ, CONTENT, EMPLY_ID) VALUES ('EQP', #{EQP_SQ}, #{CONTENT}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_SQ, EQP_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, WEB_LINK FROM TB_EEP_EQP_FILE_R WHERE EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} ORDER BY FILE_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_FILE_R (EQP_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, WEB_LINK, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{EQP_SQ}, #{DOC_CD}, #{FILE_ID}, #{FILE_NM}, #{WEB_LINK}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_EQP_FILE_R WHERE FILE_SQ = #{FILE_SQ} AND EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT e.EQP_NO, e.TYPE_CD, e.MODEL_NM, DATE_FORMAT(r.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, r.PURPOSE_NM FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_M e ON e.EQP_SQ = r.EQP_SQ WHERE r.STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND r.OPEN_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY e.TYPE_CD, e.EQP_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M e JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r ON r.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND r.OPEN_YN = 'Y' SET e.STATUS_CD = 'STOCK', e.LOCATION_NM = NULL, e.UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, e.UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE r.STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND e.STATUS_CD = 'RENT'
UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H SET OPEN_YN = 'N', END_DT = GREATEST(#{END_DT}, IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{END_DT})) WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND OPEN_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT AUDIT_SQ, AUDIT_YM FROM TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M WHERE STATUS_CD = 'OPEN' ORDER BY AUDIT_SQ DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.AUDIT_SQ, m.AUDIT_YM, m.STATUS_CD, COUNT(d.EQP_SQ) AS TOTAL, COALESCE(SUM(d.RESULT_CD = 'OK'), 0) AS OK_CNT, COALESCE(SUM(d.RESULT_CD = 'BAD'), 0) AS BAD_CNT FROM TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d ON d.AUDIT_SQ = m.AUDIT_SQ GROUP BY m.AUDIT_SQ, m.AUDIT_YM, m.STATUS_CD ORDER BY m.AUDIT_YM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M (AUDIT_YM, STATUS_CD, REG_EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{AUDIT_YM}, 'OPEN', #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID})

INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D (AUDIT_SQ, EQP_SQ, STAFF_SQ, HOLDER_NM, GUEST_YN, RESULT_CD) SELECT #{AUDIT_SQ}, e.EQP_SQ, r.STAFF_SQ, COALESCE(r.HOLDER_NM, e.LOCATION_NM), CASE WHEN s.EMPLY_ID IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, 'NONE' FROM TB_EEP_EQP_M e LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r ON r.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ AND r.OPEN_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M s ON s.STAFF_SQ = r.STAFF_SQ WHERE e.STATUS_CD IN ('RENT', 'STOCK') AND e.AUDIT_EXCL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT d.AUDIT_SQ, d.EQP_SQ, d.STAFF_SQ, d.HOLDER_NM, d.GUEST_YN, d.RESULT_CD, d.NOTE, d.RESPONSE_CD, d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(d.CHECK_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CHECK_DT , CASE WHEN d.RESPONSE_CD = 'SELF' THEN d.HOLDER_NM ELSE IFNULL(ce.EMPLY_NM, d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID) END AS CHECKER_NM , e.EQP_NO, e.TYPE_CD, e.MODEL_NM, e.STATUS_CD, s.DEPT_NM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R mm WHERE mm.TARGET_CD = 'EQP' AND mm.TARGET_SQ = d.EQP_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT FROM TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_M e ON e.EQP_SQ = d.EQP_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M s ON s.STAFF_SQ = d.STAFF_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M ce ON ce.EMPLY_ID = d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID WHERE d.AUDIT_SQ = #{AUDIT_SQ} ORDER BY e.STATUS_CD, d.HOLDER_NM, e.TYPE_CD, e.EQP_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m ON m.AUDIT_SQ = d.AUDIT_SQ SET d.RESULT_CD = #{RESULT_CD}, d.NOTE = NULLIF(#{NOTE}, ''), d.RESPONSE_CD = 'ADMIN', d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, d.CHECK_DT = NOW() WHERE d.AUDIT_SQ = #{AUDIT_SQ} AND d.EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND m.STATUS_CD = 'OPEN'

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m ON m.AUDIT_SQ = d.AUDIT_SQ SET d.RESULT_CD = #{RESULT_CD}, d.RESPONSE_CD = 'ADMIN', d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, d.CHECK_DT = NOW() WHERE d.AUDIT_SQ = #{AUDIT_SQ} AND m.STATUS_CD = 'OPEN' AND d.EQP_SQ IN #{sq}

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m ON m.AUDIT_SQ = d.AUDIT_SQ SET d.RESULT_CD = #{RESULT_CD}, d.NOTE = NULLIF(#{NOTE}, ''), d.RESPONSE_CD = 'SELF', d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, d.CHECK_DT = NOW() WHERE d.EQP_SQ = #{EQP_SQ} AND d.STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND d.GUEST_YN = 'N' AND m.STATUS_CD = 'OPEN'
UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M SET STATUS_CD = 'CLOSED', CLOSE_DT = NOW() WHERE AUDIT_SQ = #{AUDIT_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = 'OPEN'

UPDATE TB_EEP_EQP_M e JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d ON d.EQP_SQ = e.EQP_SQ SET e.LAST_CHECK_DT = DATE(d.CHECK_DT), e.LAST_CHECK_NM = d.CHECK_EMPLY_ID WHERE d.AUDIT_SQ = #{AUDIT_SQ} AND d.RESULT_CD <> 'NONE'
mapper.select: SELECT r.RENT_SQ, r.STAFF_SQ, r.HOLDER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(r.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, e.EQP_NO, e.TYPE_CD, e.MODEL_NM, e.SERIAL_NO, s.PHONE, s.EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_M e ON e.EQP_SQ = r.EQP_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M s ON s.STAFF_SQ = r.STAFF_SQ WHERE r.RENT_GROUP = #{RENT_GROUP} ORDER BY e.TYPE_CD, e.EQP_NO

SELECT SIGN_SQ, RENT_GROUP, SIGN_TP, DOC_TEXT, SIGN_IMG, FILE_NM, WEB_LINK, SIGNER_ID, SIGNER_KIND, DATE_FORMAT(SIGN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS SIGN_DT FROM TB_EEP_EQP_SIGN_H WHERE RENT_GROUP = #{RENT_GROUP}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_SIGN_H (RENT_GROUP, SIGN_TP, DOC_TEXT, SIGN_IMG, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, WEB_LINK, SIGNER_ID, SIGNER_KIND, SIGN_DT, SIGN_IP) VALUES (#{RENT_GROUP}, #{SIGN_TP}, #{DOC_TEXT}, #{SIGN_IMG}, #{FILE_ID}, #{FILE_NM}, #{WEB_LINK}, #{SIGNER_ID}, #{SIGNER_KIND}, NOW(), #{SIGN_IP})
mapper.select: SELECT SEAL_IMG FROM TB_EEP_EQP_SEAL_M WHERE SEAL_ID = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EQP_SEAL_M (SEAL_ID, SEAL_IMG, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (1, #{SEAL_IMG}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SEAL_IMG = VALUES(SEAL_IMG), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = VALUES(UPDT_EMPLY_ID), UPDT_DT = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, DEPT_NM FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}

SELECT r.RENT_SQ, r.RENT_GROUP, r.EQP_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(r.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, e.EQP_NO, e.TYPE_CD, e.MODEL_NM , CASE WHEN r.RENT_GROUP IS NOT NULL AND sg.SIGN_SQ IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SIGN_WAIT , m.AUDIT_YM, d.RESULT_CD, d.NOTE FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H r JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_M e ON e.EQP_SQ = r.EQP_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_SIGN_H sg ON sg.RENT_GROUP = r.RENT_GROUP LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_M m ON m.STATUS_CD = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EQP_AUDIT_D d ON d.AUDIT_SQ = m.AUDIT_SQ AND d.EQP_SQ = r.EQP_SQ AND d.STAFF_SQ = r.STAFF_SQ AND d.GUEST_YN = 'N' WHERE r.STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND r.OPEN_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY e.TYPE_CD, e.EQP_NO
